notes.gooch-dillard: Gooch/Dillard is two groups of houses; pinned on OSM's Gooch Houses (way/44528276), the group nearer the rest of campus (housing.virginia.edu/area/1107).

detours.why: Humphreys House faces Gilmer Hall across McCormick Road, but the nearest mapped crossing is west at the Chemistry Building, so the walk goes along McCormick Road to it and back along the far side to Gilmer Hall's door.

Skipwith Hall and the High Energy Physics buildings sit on Observatory Hill north and west of Kellogg House with no mapped path up the wooded slope from the Alderman Road dorms, so walks go round by Alderman Road and McCormick Road.
The Leander McCormick Observatory stands on top of Observatory Hill and is reached only by the winding McCormick Road up the hill.
